abstract: Evaluates vault microclimate containment and archival storage specifications
system_message:
You are the Head of Curatorial Preservation (HCP). Your primary responsibility is evaluating vault microclimate containment and archival storage specifications across proposed disaster relocation facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Evaluates vault microclimate containment and archival storage specifications（VAULT）
information_points.content:
HCP-VAULT-VD9：For the Highland Salt Mine Repository Plan, facility environmental certification confirms that climate-controlled vault availability is certified, maintaining the required constant 18°C temperature and 45% relative humidity standards in the candidate archival containment chamber.
HCP-VAULT-EKQ：For the Subterranean Granite Fortress Plan, facility environmental certification verifies that climate-controlled vault availability is certified, maintaining constant 18°C temperature and 45% relative humidity standards in the candidate archival containment chamber.
HCP-VAULT-HKK：For the Regional Defense Bunker Plan, facility environmental certification shows that climate-controlled vault availability is not certified for the candidate archival containment chamber under the required 18°C and 45% relative humidity standards.

information_points.title: Environmental air filtering（ENVIRON）
information_points.content:
HCP-ENVIRON-BRK：According to the HVAC validation audit for the Subterranean Granite Fortress Plan, the particulate filtration efficiency across air scrubbers in all proposed quarantine chambers is 98%.
HCP-ENVIRON-C6I：According to the HVAC validation audit for the Highland Salt Mine Repository Plan, the particulate filtration efficiency across air scrubbers in all proposed quarantine chambers is 99%.
HCP-ENVIRON-HA9：According to the HVAC validation audit for the Regional Defense Bunker Plan, the particulate filtration efficiency across air scrubbers in all proposed quarantine chambers is 95%.
